## Pre-registered criteria (int8 vs served int8)

- FAIL: 1 FP halved on E1 and on E2 (candidate <= half of served)
- PASS: 2 test F1 not below served by more than 0.02
- PASS: 3 recall drop <= 0.03 on test, indirect_test, tricky attacks
- PASS: 4 E3 Hinglish-attack recall not below served

**Verdict: at least one criterion fails in int8.**
